commits.comment: 修复异步调度中 spec decode padding 到 max_model_len 边界的 bug。原逻辑在 num_computed_tokens + padded_num_tokens > max_model_len 时直接 break，但当两者相等时，下一轮 max_model_len 余量为负，导致 num_scheduled_tokens 为负并崩溃。修复后要求 padding 后为 num_sampled_tokens_per_step 预留空间，并要求 num_new_tokens 满足 request_token_budget 才执行 padding。同时在测试工具中统一 ModelConfig 与 SchedulerConfig 的 max_model_len。这是调度器核心逻辑变更，影响所有启用 spec decode 的平台。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py 的 spec decode padding 逻辑变更影响所有继承或组合 vLLM Scheduler 的 vllm-ascend 自定义调度器（如 BalanceScheduler、ShortRequestFirstScheduler、BatchJobAwareScheduler）。修复要求 padding 后为采样 token 预留空间，Ascend 调度器需同步此边界检查，否则在 max_model_len 边界处可能产生负的 num_scheduled_tokens，导致 NPUModelRunner 的 input_batch 构建失败。
ascend_impact.testing: 需在 vllm-ascend 的 spec decode 测试中增加请求长度到达 max_model_len 边界的场景，验证 ngram/eagle 等方法的调度行为与 token 预算。

commits.message: [Bugfix][Scheduler] Don't pad spec decode up to `max_model_len` (#53962)

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py — RecomputeScheduler.schedule() (spec-decode padding block, ~line 722), inherited by AsyncRecomputeScheduler, DyntraLBRecomputeScheduler, AsyncDyntraLBRecomputeScheduler
vllm_ascend/core/dyntra_lb_scheduler.py — DyntraLBScheduler.schedule() (spec-decode padding block, ~line 859), inherited by AsyncDyntraLBScheduler
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This upstream commit fixes the spec-decode padding logic inside Scheduler.schedule() (vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py ~line 964), but it does NOT touch SchedulerInterface or SchedulerOutput, so there is no interface break. The impact is behavioral: vLLM's base Scheduler now (1) checks max_model_len as num_computed_tokens + padded_num_tokens + num_sampled_tokens_per_step <= max_model_len (accounting for the sampled tokens that follow the draft tokens), and (2) falls back to scheduling the request UNPADDED when the padded size would exceed max_model_len, instead of refusing to schedule (break) as before. vllm-ascend's NPUPlatform (vllm_ascend/platform.py:1215-1233, 1425-1439) selects custom schedulers that override schedule() wholesale and carry an exact copy of the OLD pre-fix padding logic, so the fix will NOT propagate to them. Adaptation: in vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py (RecomputeScheduler.schedule, the block starting ~line 722) and vllm_ascend/core/dyntra_lb_scheduler.py (DyntraLBScheduler.schedule, the block starting ~line 859), replace: num_new_tokens = 1 + self.num_spec_tokens; if num_new_tokens > token_budget or num_computed_tokens + num_new_tokens > self.max_model_len: break; pad_spec_decode = True with the new logic: padded_num_tokens = 1 + self.num_spec_tokens; if num_computed_tokens + padded_num_tokens + self.num_sampled_tokens_per_step <= self.max_model_len: if padded_num_tokens > token_budget: break; num_new_tokens = padded_num_tokens; pad_spec_decode = True. (Note: the ascend copies use `token_budget` where upstream used `request_token_budget`; keep ascend's existing variable convention but apply the new structure.) Because the Async/DyntraLB variants inherit schedule() from these two classes, editing the two base schedule() implementations covers all variants. No changes needed for BalanceScheduler (already clamps with num_sampled_tokens_per_step, patch_balance_schedule.py:252), BatchJobAwareScheduler (delegates to super().schedule()), ProfilingChunkScheduler, or ShortRequestFirstAsyncScheduler.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. The change is a small, localized port of a logic block with no signature/interface change, but it alters spec-decode scheduling behavior near the max_model_len boundary: un-padded fallback means a decode step no longer preserves full cudagraph batch shape, and the new num_sampled_tokens_per_step accounting prevents over-allocating positions past max_model_len. Risk of not porting: RecomputeScheduler/DyntraLBScheduler retain the over-padding bug and inconsistent scheduling vs upstream and vs BalanceScheduler. Verify with spec-decode (MTP/EAGLE/DSpark) + long-context tests near max_model_len on NPU; ensure self.num_sampled_tokens_per_step is set on these scheduler instances (it is initialized in the base Scheduler.__init__, so it is available).

[1/N][KV Connector] Identify externally transferable KV cache groups (#53779)

Signed-off-by: Matthew Bonanni <mbonanni@redhat.com>

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This is 1/N of the upstream [KV Connector] series. It adds KVCacheGroupSpec.enable_kv_transfer (default True) and KVCacheConfig.transfer_group_ids / transfer_groups / transfer_group_index_by_layer / select_transfer_block_ids() in vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py, then migrates vllm's Mooncake-store and NIXL connectors to transfer only 'externally transferable' groups. For vllm-ascend, the immediate change is backward-compatible: every KVCacheGroupSpec(...) construction in vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_utils.py (Kimi K3 DSpark mixed groups, DeepSeek V4 full-MLA/SWA groups) and all reads of kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups still work because the new field/methods are additive and all groups default to transferable. However, adaptation is required to keep vllm-ascend's own KV connectors consistent with the new contract as later commits set enable_kv_transfer=False (e.g., for EAGLE/MTP draft groups): (1) In vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_utils.py, when building KVCacheGroupSpec for Kimi K3 DSpark / DeepSeek V4, decide whether EAGLE/draft and Mamba groups should set enable_kv_transfer=False and mirror the upstream grouping. (2) Update vllm-ascend's connectors/schedulers that iterate kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups and index per-group block IDs to use kv_cache_config.transfer_groups and kv_cache_config.select_transfer_block_ids(blocks.get_block_ids()) instead: MooncakeConnectorScheduler.update_state_after_alloc / request_finished / exchange_clipped-blocks paths in kv_p2p/mooncake_connector.py (also its transfer_group_id index computation at ~L2350-2402), KVPoolScheduler in kv_pool/ascend_store/pool_scheduler.py (normalize_block_ids_by_group / _update_state_after_alloc and the assert len(block_ids)==len(kv_cache_groups) at ~L432), KVPoolWorker, RecomputeCPUOffloadConnectorV1/manager._derive_cpu_config, UCMConnectorV1, and SparseKVOffloadManager (which asserts len(kv_cache_groups)==1 at sparse_kv_offload_manager.py:415). (3) Note the index-shift hazard: select_transfer_block_ids returns a condensed tuple (transferable groups only), so any code that assumes group i of block_ids maps 1:1 to kv_cache_groups[i] must switch to transfer_group_index_by_layer / transfer_group_ids. No vllm-ascend code currently sets enable_kv_transfer, so no runtime breakage; this is a forward-compatibility alignment task.
deep_analysis.risk: Low for this commit itself (new dataclass field has a default of True and all new KVCacheConfig APIs are additive; vllm-ascend overrides every affected vllm connector -- MooncakeConnectorV1/Hybrid/Layerwise, MooncakeConnectorStoreV1/AscendStoreConnector, UCMConnector, etc. -- so the modified vllm mooncake/store and nixl files are not exercised by vllm-ascend). Main risk is divergence later in the series: if upstream sets enable_kv_transfer=False on EAGLE/MTP or Mamba draft groups, vllm-ascend's connectors (which still transfer all kv_cache_groups) would transfer non-transferable state or mismatch block-ID layouts, and the condensed transfer-group indexing can silently misalign per-group block tables in hybrid (attention+mamba / MLA) and spec-decode models unless the mapping above is adopted consistently.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
The commit makes GPUModelRunner.capture_model pass `pcp_manager=self.pcp_manager` unconditionally into ModelCudaGraphManager.capture, which forwards it to prepare_inputs_to_capture so PIECEWISE graph capture uses PCP dummy slot mappings (from PCPManager.get_dummy_slot_mappings, shape num_tokens*pcp_world_size) instead of block_tables dummy slot mappings. vllm-ascend overrides capture in ModelAclGraphManager (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py, lines 170-199) with a signature that has no `pcp_manager` parameter and drops it when calling super().capture(...) — this raises `TypeError: capture() got an unexpected keyword argument 'pcp_manager'` at graph-capture time for MRV2/310V2 even when PCP is disabled (the kwarg is passed always). Required adaptation:
1. In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py: add `pcp_manager: 'PCPManager | None' = None` to ModelAclGraphManager.capture (import under TYPE_CHECKING from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.pcp_manager), and forward it: super().capture(..., pcp_manager=pcp_manager, ...) (or pass self.model_runner.pcp_manager). Keep the existing ModelWithContext wrapping and communicator_switch().
2. Verify AscendPCPManager (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/pcp_manager.py) inherits the base get_dummy_slot_mappings (it does not override it) and that AscendModelState.prepare_attn (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/default.py) plus AscendPCPManager.build_attention_context dummy branch (slot_mappings.view(shape[0], pcp_world_size, local_num_tokens)[:, pcp_rank]) operate correctly with the gathered PCP dummy slot mappings produced by prepare_inputs_to_capture — this is the semantic core of the fix for PCP + PIECEWISE capture.
3. NPUModelRunner310V2 (vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py) inherits NPUModelRunner/ModelAclGraphManager, so fixing aclgraph_utils covers it; just confirm its initialize_kv_cache still creates ModelAclGraphManager with the same capture path.
4. Optionally mirror the new upstream test test_piecewise_capture_uses_pcp_dummy_slot_mappings in tests/ut/worker/test_pcp_manager_v2.py.
5. MRV1 (vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py) uses the base ModelCudaGraphManager (only EncoderCudaGraphManager is swapped) and needs no change.
deep_analysis.risk: High if not adapted: every MRV2/310V2 startup with cudagraph_mode != NONE (FULL or PIECEWISE, e.g. the new eval configs using cudagraph_mode PIECEWISE) will fail in capture_model with `TypeError: capture() got an unexpected keyword argument 'pcp_manager'`, since the kwarg is passed even when PCP is disabled. If the signature is fixed but pcp_manager is not forwarded to super().capture/prepare_inputs_to_capture, PCP + PIECEWISE graph capture on NPU would silently fall back to non-PCP dummy slot mappings, reproducing the very bug this commit fixes (wrong slot-mapping width for gathered KV writes) and risking incorrect attention metadata/crashes during PCP prefill capture.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Upstream vLLM commit 5acc1c4e4b87 renames the `propose()` parameter `num_tokens_across_dp: torch.Tensor | None` to `dp_sync: DPSyncState | None` (new frozen dataclass in vllm/v1/worker/gpu/dp_utils.py) across `BaseSpeculator.propose`, `AutoRegressiveSpeculator.propose`, `DFlashSpeculator.propose`, and `MultiModuleMTPSpeculator.propose`. `GPUModelRunner.sample_tokens()` and `GPUModelRunner._dummy_run()` now pass `dp_sync=dp_sync` as a keyword arg (sourced from `ExecuteModelState.dp_sync`). Because vllm-ascend's speculators override `propose()` with the old signature (no `dp_sync` parameter), invoking any of them after this bump raises `TypeError: propose() got an unexpected keyword argument 'dp_sync'` for DP>1 EAGLE/MTP/DFlash/DSpark runs. Required changes: (1) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/autoregressive/speculator.py, dflash/speculator.py, and dspark/speculator.py, add `from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.dp_utils import DPSyncState`, change each `propose(self, ..., num_tokens_across_dp: torch.Tensor | None = None, ...)` to `dp_sync: DPSyncState | None = None`, and forward `dp_sync=dp_sync` to `super().propose(...)` (do NOT forward the old raw tensor, since `dispatch_cg_and_sync_dp`/`sync_cudagraph_and_dp_padding` now assert on `dp_sync.eager`, `dp_sync.uniform_token_count`, `dp_sync.num_tokens_across_dp`). (2) The internal Ascend overrides `_run_model`/`_generate_draft`/`_prefill`/`_multi_step_decode` keep their unchanged `num_tokens_across_dp` params and need no edit. (3) `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py` imports upstream `ExecuteModelState` only as a type annotation (the NamedTuple field `num_tokens_across_dp` was replaced by `dp_sync`); it does not construct it, so only a review is needed. (4) Confirm AutoRegressiveAclGraphManager/DFlashAclGraphManager `run_fullgraph` still computes local `num_tokens_across_dp` for set_forward_context (unchanged, correct). Note: reuse of the target's DPSyncState skips the second DP all_reduce before draft prefill; Ascend's ACL graph managers dispatch against the same batch shape so the added assertions should hold, but this should be e2e-tested on NPU with DP>1.

commits.comment: 修复 DP 暂停（pause）完成时未保证设备空闲的问题。此前 pause_scheduler 在清空 cache 前不等待 worker 上最后的 dummy batch 执行完毕，可能在设备仍有 in-flight 工作时 reset KV cache，造成数据竞争。修复方案：WorkerBase 新增 synchronize_device 方法（默认 torch.accelerator.synchronize()）；EngineCore 新增 _finish_pause，在 pause 完成路径上先通过 collective_rpc 调用所有 worker 的 synchronize_device，再执行 _reset_caches；GPUWorker.wake_up 后也调用 synchronize_device 确保恢复后设备同步。测试覆盖 pause 的 wait/abort 模式、sleep 状态下 pause、以及通过 dummy batch 延迟验证 pause 返回时设备已 idle。风险中低，但新增的同步点可能略微增加 pause 延迟。

ascend_impact.functionality: WorkerBase 新增 synchronize_device 方法，EngineCore 的 pause 完成路径会通过 collective_rpc 调用该接口。vllm-ascend 的 NPUWorker 继承 WorkerBase，默认实现为 `torch.accelerator.synchronize()`（在 torch_npu 下可用）。但若 NPUWorker 覆写了 wake_up 且未调用 super().wake_up()，则 GPUWorker 中新增的 wake_up 后同步不会生效，需在 NPUWorker 的 wake_up/sleep 恢复路径中显式调用 synchronize_device；同时 NPUWorker 若存在自定义 stream（如 ACL graph 重放流），可能需要覆写 synchronize_device 以同步 NPU 特有流。
ascend_impact.testing: 需要更新 vllm-ascend 的 DP pause/resume 测试，验证 pause 完成后 NPU 设备空闲、wake_up 后设备同步，以及 sleep 状态下 pause 的 consensus 行为。

commits.message:
[Bugfix][DP] Synchronize the device on pause completion (#52914)

Signed-off-by: aoshen02 <aoshen@inferact.ai>

affected_interfaces: NPUWorker (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:111) - inherits the new WorkerBase.synchronize_device() method and overrides wake_up(); must override synchronize_device() and add the device-sync to its own wake_up()

vllm_ascend DP engine-core subclasses (BalanceDPEngineCoreProc, DyntraLBDPEngineCoreProc) - consume the new EngineCore._finish_pause()/collective_rpc("synchronize_device") path during DP pause, which now relies on worker synchronize_device()
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) In vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py, override synchronize_device() on NPUWorker to call torch.npu.synchronize() instead of relying on the inherited default (torch.accelerator.synchronize()). Upstream's docstring explicitly says backends outside torch.accelerator must override, and vllm-ascend already monkey-patches torch.accelerator memory APIs to torch.npu in patch/platform/patch_torch_accelerator.py because torch.accelerator does not reliably delegate to NPU - synchronize() should be treated the same way for correctness on all torch_npu versions. 2) Mirror the GPUWorker.wake_up() change: add self.synchronize_device() (or torch.npu.synchronize()) at the end of NPUWorker.wake_up() (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:265), after sleep_wakeup_manager.wakeup()/post_kv_cache_wake_up(), so the wake-from-pause path gets the same 'idle device before caches are touched' guarantee. 3) No change needed in the engine-core: EngineCore._finish_pause()'s collective_rpc("synchronize_device") resolves the method on the worker by name and will find the NPUWorker override; verify the DP pause path (abort/keep/wait + clear_cache) with the BalanceScheduler/DyntraLB DP engine cores.
deep_analysis.risk: If synchronize_device() is not overridden and torch.accelerator.synchronize() fails to route to NPU on a given torch_npu version, the pause completion path (collective_rpc + _reset_caches) could race with in-flight NPU work (the exact bug this commit fixes), risking use-after-free on KV cache/allocator reset during DP idle ranks; omitting the wake_up() sync reintroduces the same race on the sleep/wake-up path. Low overall risk: the change is purely additive (new method + one call site) with no signature changes to existing WorkerBase methods.
